name: shopify-theme-editorial-discovery
description: Shopify Theme - Editorial Discovery with GSAP animations and Git Subtree deployment scripts

scripts.theme:push: git subtree split --prefix theme -b temp-deploy-branch && git push origin temp-deploy-branch:deploy-theme --force && git branch -D temp-deploy-branch
scripts.theme:pull: git fetch origin deploy-theme && git checkout origin/deploy-theme -- theme/
